message.content: I have three junk WIP commits at the start of my feature branch. How do I get rid of them but keep the rest?

content.text:
Run this from the repository root:

```
git rebase --onto main feature~5 feature
```

It replays the commits after `feature~5` onto `main` and moves the `feature` ref to the result, so the three WIP commits are no longer on the branch.
